payload.title: Proxy Database Forensics
payload.description: This notebook aims to identify the differences and similarities between two proxy databases using the `cfr.ProxyDatabase` class. By comparing these databases, the notebook seeks to understand how variations in proxy data inputs can affect the quality of paleoclimate reconstructions.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for proxy database analysis.
steps.title: Import Libraries

steps.description: Load the two proxy databases as `cfr.ProxyDatabase` objects and refresh them to ensure data integrity.
steps.title: Load Proxy Databases

steps.description: Plot the two proxy databases to visualize their data distribution.
steps.title: Plot Proxy Databases

steps.description: Compare the PID lists of the two databases to identify overlapping and missing records.
steps.title: Compare Record Identifiers

steps.description: Convert the differences in record identifiers into `ProxyDatabase` objects for further analysis.
steps.title: Convert Differences to ProxyDatabase Objects

steps.description: Plot the records that are missing in each database to visually identify discrepancies.
steps.title: Plot Missing Records

steps.description: Plot overlapping records to check if individual records are the same across both databases.
steps.title: Plot Overlapping Records

steps.description: Plot the start times for each proxy database to identify differences in record initiation times.
steps.title: Plot Start Times
